name: Dashboard style (CSS)
format:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --sac-bg: #0b1120; --sac-card: #111827; --sac-card2: #0f172a; --sac-border: #1f2937;
  --sac-text: #e5e7eb; --sac-muted: #94a3b8; --sac-accent: #22d3ee;
  --sac-ok: #22c55e; --sac-bad: #ef4444; --sac-warn: #f59e0b; --sac-cmd: #818cf8;
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme, body.nr-dashboard-theme md-content, body.nr-dashboard-theme #Tab_content {
  background: var(--sac-bg) !important;
}
body, md-card, ui-card-panel, .nr-dashboard-template, md-toast {
  font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif !important;
}
/* Cards (groups) */
.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel {
  background: var(--sac-card) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--sac-border) !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35) !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel p.nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
  color: var(--sac-muted) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important; font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 12px 16px 0 !important; margin: 0 !important;
  width: auto !important; box-sizing: border-box !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardpanel { overflow: hidden; }
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-template { padding: 0 !important; background: transparent !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-switch, .nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-slider { padding: 0 16px !important; box-sizing: border-box !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-chart { padding: 0 14px 10px !important; box-sizing: border-box; }
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-gauge { padding-top: 6px; }
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-switch .label, .nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-slider p.label {
  color: var(--sac-text) !important; font-size: 14px !important; font-weight: 500;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.md-checked .md-bar { background-color: rgba(34, 211, 238, .45) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.md-checked .md-thumb { background-color: var(--sac-accent) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-slider .md-track-fill, .nr-dashboard-theme md-slider .md-thumb:after { background-color: var(--sac-accent) !important; border-color: var(--sac-accent) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-slider .md-sign { background-color: var(--sac-accent) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-slider .md-sign:after { border-top-color: var(--sac-accent) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-slider .md-thumb-text { color: #0b1120 !important; font-weight: 700; }
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-gauge .gage-title, .nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-gauge text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important; }
md-toast.md-default-theme .md-toast-content, md-toast .md-toast-content {
  background: #7f1d1d !important; border: 1px solid #ef4444; border-radius: 10px !important; font-weight: 500;
}

/* Header + KPI tiles */
.sac-wrap { padding: 18px 20px; color: var(--sac-text); }
.sac-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sac-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.sac-logo { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0891b2, #22d3ee); color: #0b1120; font-size: 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(34, 211, 238, .35); }
.sac-h1 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.01em; line-height: 1.2; }
.sac-sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sac-muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.sac-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sac-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid; }
.sac-pill .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.sac-pill.ok { color: var(--sac-ok); background: rgba(34, 197, 94, .1); border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, .35); }
.sac-pill.ok .dot { animation: sac-pulse 1.8s infinite; }
.sac-pill.bad { color: var(--sac-bad); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, .1); border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, .35); }
.sac-updated { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sac-muted); }
.sac-updated b { color: var(--sac-text); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.sac-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-top: 18px; }
.sac-tile { background: var(--sac-card2); border: 1px solid var(--sac-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px;
  transition: border-color .3s, box-shadow .3s; }
.sac-tile.on { border-color: rgba(34, 211, 238, .55); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(34, 211, 238, .15), 0 0 24px rgba(34, 211, 238, .12); }
.sac-tile-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--sac-muted); }
.sac-tile-top .fa { font-size: 15px; color: var(--sac-muted); }
.sac-fan { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--sac-muted); }
.sac-tile.on .sac-fan { color: var(--sac-accent); animation: sac-spin 1s linear infinite; }
.sac-val { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 8px; letter-spacing: -.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.sac-val small { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sac-muted); margin-left: 2px; }
.sac-tile.on .sac-val { color: var(--sac-accent); }
.sac-cap { font-size: 12px; color: var(--sac-muted); margin-top: 4px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
@keyframes sac-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes sac-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .35; } }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .sac-tiles { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

/* Hint under the controls */
.sac-hint { margin: 4px 14px 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--sac-muted); background: var(--sac-card2); border: 1px solid var(--sac-border); }
.sac-hint b { color: var(--sac-text); font-weight: 600; }

/* Activity log */
.sac-log { padding: 6px 14px 10px; height: 100%; overflow-y: auto; box-sizing: border-box; }
.sac-log-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sac-border); font-size: 12.5px; }
.sac-log-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sac-log-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; background: var(--sac-muted); }
.sac-log-row.ok .sac-log-dot { background: var(--sac-ok); }
.sac-log-row.alert .sac-log-dot { background: var(--sac-bad); }
.sac-log-row.cmd .sac-log-dot { background: var(--sac-cmd); }
.sac-log-text { flex: 1; color: var(--sac-text); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.sac-log-time { color: var(--sac-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11.5px; }
.sac-log-empty { color: var(--sac-muted); font-size: 12.5px; padding: 12px 0; }
</style>
